caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular quilt design on a beige, slightly textured background. The quilt is composed of five block patterns arranged in a cross formation, each block featuring geometric shapes in a variety of colors: predominantly pink, yellow, blue, and off-white, with accents of red and patterned prints in some sections. The center and two diagonal blocks have a solid pink square in the middle, while the remaining two have a solid tan or beige square. Surrounding these central squares are triangular and rectangular pieces forming a stylized, symmetrical pattern with the colored triangles extending outward. The quilt background features a repeating pattern of arcuate, fan-like lines in a light blue-gray, forming a scalloped motif across the surface. The outer edge of the quilt is delineated by a thin, slightly darker outline. The drawing is bordered by a generous margin of plain paper, and a signature or name appears in the lower right corner.
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
